n0a46d95e32.headline: Zimbabwe on course to meet 2020 budget deficit target -finmin
n0a46d95e32.summary: Zimbabwe’s finance minister said the country is on course to meet its 2020 budget deficit target of 1.5% of GDP, according to a key update absent from the mid-term budget.
n0a46d95e32.why: Budget deficit targets reflect fiscal discipline and impact investor confidence and sovereign creditworthiness in emerging markets like Zimbabwe.

nb0cb7c585f.headline: Madbouly follows up with the head of the Investment Authority on several important files.. 1672 companies established with capital of 7.9 billion pounds last month
nb0cb7c585f.summary: Egypt's Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly met with the Investment Authority CEO to discuss the establishment of 1,672 companies with a capital of 7.9 billion Egyptian pounds last month.
nb0cb7c585f.why: Company formation and capital investment levels are key indicators of economic activity and business confidence in Egypt.
